I visited the CCWJ as an intern in 2018 and am back for my PhD again! I come from Nanchang City, China and also stayed for a long time in Harbin, China, which is the about the same temperature as Edmonton. My biggest interest is in aerospace and I dream to travel far away from earth – but not for a long time (quite lonely up there, I guess). I like music including singing and guitar. Up to now, I published a paper regarding the application of deep learning to satellite images, and also had a paper about the dynamic simulation of satellites. In the future, I will try my best to do the work of FSW especially in the rocket area.

## Project

I am now working on the model of friction stire welding. I used to do research about object detection in the remote sensing images of satellites and also established the hardware-in-loop test platform of satellites.
